title: Noah's Ship and Nations Who Denied Their Messengers

paragraphs.text: Allah told Noah to build the ship under His watch. When the command came and the oven overflowed, he was to bring two of every kind, and his family. Those already decreed to perish were left out. Noah was not to speak for the wrongdoers, because they would drown. On the ship, he should praise Allah for saving them from the wrongdoing people. He should ask Allah to let him land at a blessed place. In this story there are signs, and Allah always tests His servants.

After them, Allah raised another generation and sent them a messenger from among them. He also told them to worship Allah alone. Their rich leaders denied the Hereafter. They said he was only a man who eats and drinks like them. They said obeying him would make them losers. They mocked the promise of rising again after becoming dust and bones. They said there is only this life, and called him a liar. The messenger asked Allah for help. Allah said they would soon regret. Then a mighty shriek seized them, and they became like dry stubble.

Then Allah raised other generations. No nation can come before its fixed time or stay after it. Allah sent His messengers one after another. Each nation denied its messenger, so they were destroyed one after another and became only stories.

hardWords.m: people living at the same time
laughed at in an unkind way
dry, cut stems left in a field
